faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Onne Fit.
faq.a0: Yes! The free plan includes workout planning, progress charts, XP system, social feed, and up to 3 AI queries per month. No payment required.
faq.a1: The Free plan covers the essentials. Essential adds more AI queries (15/month) and extra goals. Pro unlocks unlimited AI and advanced analytics. Premium includes everything + priority support and early access.
faq.q2: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a2: Yes, no commitment. You can cancel whenever you want and keep access until the end of your billing period.
faq.q3: How does Onne Fit's AI work?
faq.a3: Our AI generates personalized workout and diet plans based on your profile (weight, height, goals, restrictions). It's like having a personal trainer and nutritionist available 24/7.
faq.a4: Absolutely. All data is encrypted and protected. Health information is private and never shared with third parties.
faq.q5: Do I need equipment to use the app?
faq.a5: Not necessarily. The AI can generate workouts for the gym, home, or bodyweight-only, adapted to what you have available.
faq.q6: Can I use Onne Fit as a personal trainer?
faq.a6: Yes! By activating Trainer mode, you get a complete dashboard to manage students, create workouts, and track their progress.
faq.a7: Onne Fit is a PWA (Progressive Web App). Some features work offline, but AI and data sync require an internet connection.
